A [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]<ref name="PLEG" /> hunter called '''Ramy''' lived<ref name="WH" /> on the moon [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]<ref name="PLEG" /> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> hunting down captive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;typically [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] but sometimes [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]&mdash;for sport.<ref name="PL">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref> He was stationed at the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|floating fortress]], when it was infiltrated by three Jedi&mdash;[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]] and [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]]&mdash;and the<ref name="WH" /> [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]<ref name="CDB">{{DB|character|chewbacca|Chewbacca}}</ref> [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. When the intruders appeared behind them on a hover pod, Ramy hissed at the group, while [[Lagon/Legends|Lagon]] was thrown off the edge of the fortress. The Trandoshans overwhelmed the prisoners, but when [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] reinforcements arrived, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] threw Ramy out of the fortress.<ref name="WH" /> Ramy survived the fall and later traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] alongside fellow survivor [[Krix/Legends|Krix]].<ref name="FaE">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ramy first appeared in Episode 21 of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' animated series]]&mdash;"''[[Padawan Lost]]''"<ref name="PL" />&mdash;and was identified properly in the corresponding episode guide. Ramy's name comes from [[Mary Franklin]], the editor of ''[[Bantha Tracks (department)|Bantha Tracks]]'' and a huge fan of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]].<ref name="PLEG" />
